subject.title: refactor(memory-wiki): move compiled cache to plugin state

question: Should OpenClaw accept `registerMemoryPromptPreparation` as a durable public plugin-SDK lifecycle contract for asynchronous state preparation?
rationale: The PR adds a documented public registration that external plugins can rely on; the plugin API direction and lifecycle/error contract require maintainer intent beyond a local refactor review.

options.title: Accept the public lifecycle
options.body: Keep the registration after resolving the digest-read regression and documenting the intended compatibility contract.

options.title: Keep preparation internal
options.body: Move the asynchronous preparation behind a narrower internal or owner-specific seam if maintainers do not want a new external SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the public lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep the registration after resolving the digest-read regression and documenting the intended compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history connects this contributor to the proposed SDK lifecycle and all major runtime integrations.
